facts.fact: The Consorcio Eleitoral Mais Integridade observer report says the 2023 voter registration was carried out with mobile digital biometric kits (laptop, ten-finger scanner, camera, signature screen, card printer), used from field capture through data storage and compilation of the final rolls.
facts.system: recenseamento eleitoral biometrico (STAE biometric registration kits)
